sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
The Out of Home Advertising Association of America (OAAA) is a trade association founded in 1891 that represents the US out of home advertising industry with 800+ members including media companies, advertisers, agencies, ad-tech providers, and suppliers.

Industry: Trade Association · HQ: Washington, D.C. · Size: not published

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Create an OAAA Account scores 19 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 85% confidence. The score is carried by application fit (16/25). Nothing was found for industry fit, company size and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Drytac (15% similar on media, advertising, life, out); Mactac (11% similar on media, advertising, digital, vehicle); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (6% similar on advertising, performance, vehicle, digital). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Industry fit: 3 more core category terms in its positioning would reach the ceiling.
• Company size: Any published revenue or headcount would unlock up to 15 points.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
• Flags on the record: size unknown
